Hi Michael,

I'm Jon Clark, and I'm interested in your 2016 Nissan Altima. Before I come look at it, I wanted to level-set on the numbers and the car's condition.

With 83,223 miles, KBB shows a private-party range of about $10,990–$12,540, with a fair-market value right around $11,765. Your ask of $12,600 is above even the top of that range, so I need to understand what justifies the premium.

Can you tell me about the mechanical history? Do you have complete maintenance records? Any current mechanical issues, dashboard warning lights, deferred maintenance, or upcoming major services—like CVT work, brakes, tires, or suspension items? Any accidents on the Carfax?

Assuming the car is mechanically clean, I'd be looking to start the conversation well below your ask—closer to **$10,800**. That said, if there are defects or upcoming repair costs, I'd have to subtract those expenses in full from a market-based offer rather than split the difference. Let me know where things stand.
